scores.rationale: Bessemer melamine steak platters are collectable but a mixed set of about 13 pieces realistically sells around $40-80.
Unmarked Australian souvenir pottery and Wade-type dishes; maker unconfirmed, likely $30-60 as a group.
Mixed household china; pair of uranium glass vases is the main value, Bunnykins unconfirmed, perhaps $40-70 total.
Junghans electro-gong battery mantel clock, genuine maker but common 1960s-70s model, about $60-120.
Unlabelled 1960s cord-weave saucer chairs, pair realistically $60-120.
Boxed Moorgate pantograph with instructions, worn box, small niche market, about $30-60.
Mixed tub of reproductions and mid-century photos; calligraphy plate likely a later reproduction, grubby mounts, low value.
Dozen-plus wooden hat blocks plus stand have real milliner demand, realistic $150-300 for the two boxes.
Ovation round-back with original case; US-made would be $300-600, but a Celebrity is possible, so discounted to a mix around $250-400.
Unused millinery stock (sinamay, veiling, bases) sells to hobby milliners, but bulk lots typically fetch $40-80.
